criterion: Supplier legal entity and OEM authorisation
evidence_required: Original company and OEM confirmation; beneficiary independently matched
Regulatory hardware code; OS/browser/SDK versions; interfaces and optional features
Exact model/certificate evidence and importer responsibilities; not brand-only
Named authorised centre confirms this serial/region; turnaround and freight in writing
OEM-supported lifecycle dates; device usable across planned service horizon
Named commit/build executes six buttons; correct navigation/accessibility on target runtime
Actual target unit prints/reads correct item and amount with status/error handling
Actual network loss/reboot retains permitted actions and deduplicates; payment approval not simulated as live
Authorised positive/negative role tests; encrypted recovery; consent/retention evidence
Actual eight-hour workload log; compatible certified charger/backup
Written local supply/support and accessible user training trial
Approved funding model; trader consent; no imposed credit or bank switch
Dated written scope; all cost categories known; no hidden recurring/FX/returns costs
Named reviewer independent of test execution assesses original artifacts
Fit/protection/stand/power/connectivity/start-card/ownership/support evidence, actual alert and missed-order tests; all-in funded cost
Independent trainee teach-back and practical provisioning, diagnosis, recovery, replacement and trainer assessment; accepted reusable handover materials

criterion: Written local service and warranty authority
evidence_required: OEM-confirmed permitted repairs, named authorised scope, tools/licences, spares, warranty boundaries and escalation route
